critical.evidence: The inline worker PASS was weaker than context_verdict and _score_w11 and omitted truncation, 10 GiB, swap, telemetry, four stages, and strict identity.
critical.reproduction_instructions: Compare the worker cleanup formula with glm52_goal.py.
critical.proposed_acceptance_test: Generate immutable manifest/raw/summary artifacts and mutation-test every omitted condition.

high.evidence: The attempt was active and had no terminal stage, manifest, summary, retrieval, release, or restore evidence at review time.
high.reproduction_instructions: Inspect the attempt directory and service.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: Require a terminal result; timeout or missing evidence is FAIL/NO_RESULT.

high.evidence: Missing or sub-10 GiB telemetry did not affect the worker verdict; swap was neither prohibited nor sampled.
high.reproduction_instructions: Delete memory.jsonl or insert a 9 GiB sample in a completed copy.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: Require <=0.5-second coverage, >=10 GiB, zero cgroup swap, and live watchdog coverage.

high.evidence: The probe accepted length and combined hidden reasoning_content with final content for retrieval scoring.
high.reproduction_instructions: Put records only in reasoning_content or return finish_reason=length.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: Score final content only and require finish_reason=stop.

high.evidence: The manifest omitted binary libraries, model shards, tokenizer, fixture, launcher, scheduler, flags, and scorer; startup used size-only weights.

high.evidence: The long run executed mutable live scripts and never rechecked candidate cleanliness or hashes.
high.reproduction_instructions: Trace the live paths used by worker, probe, launcher, and restore.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: Execute a read-only frozen attempt tree and verify all hashes before and after.

medium.proposed_acceptance_test: Require terminal completion, >=10 GiB, no OOM/Xid, and verified restore.
